services.title: Earthworks & excavation
services.long: General earthworks, bulk and detailed excavation, cut and fill, land levelling with machine control, and building pads.

services.title: Roads & subdivisions
services.long: Road construction and upgrades, kerbing, and residential and commercial subdivisions.

services.title: Land clearing & dams
services.long: Land clearing and site preparation, dam building, rock retaining walls, rock breaking and avocado mounding.

services.title: Water, sewer & stormwater
services.long: Water and sewer reticulation, sewer pump stations, rising and irrigation mains, stormwater, electrical and communications reticulation, with poly and electrofusion welding.

services.title: Concrete works & driveways
services.long: Concrete works, driveways, drainage, trenches, sedimentation traps and environmental projects.

services.title: Plant hire & haulage
services.long: Excavators, graders, dozers, rollers, scrapers, backhoes, loaders, skid steers, water trucks, truck and dog, float and bulk or heavy haulage. Sand and gravel supplies too.

aboutParas: Hawe Earthmoving has been a civil contracting firm in Bundaberg since 1968. It started with a single dozer and has grown on the back of quality service.

Today the family-owned business takes on civil, commercial and rural projects of all sizes across Bundaberg and the Wide Bay Burnett, from road construction and subdivisions to dams, drainage and concrete works, with its own fleet of plant for hire.
